review.claim_ceiling_assessment: Compact layer supports at most a draft L2–L3 self-reported operational/diagnostic inventory with a blocked zero-execution control and explicit non-execution of QIT/Ratchet engines. It does not independently support L4 Lev verdict language, true integration promotion, release eligibility, or any scientific/QIT/Ratchet/terrain/flux/cosmogenesis claim. All estate-backed receipts, mutation tests, stress case bodies, and byte-identical replay proofs require the omitted ~2.5 MB estate and are not independently verifiable from this compact evidence alone.
